facts:
Focus now: Getting the Hexfall match server ready for the season 3 launch
Pieces of work:
- Ranked matchmaking (also called the ranked queue): being worked on now. Players are paired by rating. Parts: large regions: matches form quickly; small regions: too few players are online, so the queue takes too long. Changed at this step.
- Match replays: delivered. Every ranked match is saved and can be played back. Changed at this step.
- Reconnects (also called rejoin after a drop): being worked on now. A player whose connection drops can rejoin the match. Parts: desktop: rejoin works; mobile: rejoin fails after the app goes to the background.
- Season rewards: waits on something outside the session. The reward logic is built; the art team has not delivered the reward card art.
- Spectator mode: not started yet. Watching a live match without playing in it; nothing is built yet.
Open asks:
- none
Not work:
- rule: Keep each match server instance under 2 GB of memory
- finding: The admin console's login page has no rate limit; outside this task
Running work:
- Tunes the ranked queue so matches in small regions form faster, for Ranked matchmaking
- Lets mobile players rejoin a match after a dropped connection, for Reconnects
